title: DeepMind and Google
text: DeepMind was founded by Demis Hassabis in London. DeepMind developed AlphaGo. Google acquired DeepMind in 2014. Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google. Google is a subsidiary of Alphabet. Alphabet is headquartered in Mountain View.

title: OpenAI
text: OpenAI was founded by Sam Altman. OpenAI developed GPT-4. Microsoft partnered with OpenAI. Microsoft is headquartered in Redmond. Satya Nadella is the CEO of Microsoft.

title: Anthropic
text: Anthropic was founded by Dario Amodei. Anthropic developed Claude. Amazon partnered with Anthropic. Amazon is headquartered in Seattle. Andy Jassy is the CEO of Amazon.
